messages:
marta: Morning — getting pinged about an SLO burn on /v1/generate (SLO-BURN-1173). Does anyone know the canonical place to pull raw traces + the Prom/Loki queries that backed the alert? Need to attach evidence to the RCA and propose a short-term tuning if it's noisy.

chris: Grafana panel: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/slo-overview/slo-burns
PromQL for burn rate (30m window):
```
(sum(rate(errors_total{route="/v1/generate"}[30m]))
/
(sum(rate(requests_total{route="/v1/generate"}[30m])))
) / on() group_left() (SLO_TARGET)
```
Loki quick for traces with error stack:
```
{app="inference-api"} |= "error" |= "kv cache miss" | json | line_format "{tenant} {trace_id} {msg}"
```
Those are the panels I usually attach.

marta: perfect, thanks. Any guidance on a safe short-term tuning? ops wants a concrete change I can propose.

devin: If it's a noisy transient spike, bumping the burn rate threshold or lengthening the evaluation window helps. Two simple options:
- Increase burn window to 60m (reduces sensitivity to short bursts)
- Add a second-tier alert: warn at 2x for 30m, critical at 3x for 60m
Example alert patch (alerts repo): https://git.internal/redwood/alerts/pulls/452

raj: also check per-tenant breakdown before tuning — if one tenant caused it we shouldn't relax global SLOs. Grafana panel: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/tenant-breakdown/tenant-errors

olivia: I can run a quick aggregation query to confirm whether errors were tenant-scoped. Running now, will post results.

alerts-bot: [ALERT] SLO-BURN-1173 triggered at 2026-03-17T09:12:45Z — burn_rate=3.4x, window=30m, route=/v1/generate — link: https://alerts.redwood.internal/alerts/1173

olivia: quick summary — 72% of the error spikes came from tenant_id=acme-inc (api key a1b...), 2 trace ids with repeated KV cache timeouts (trace: 7f4a3c, 8b1d22). Attaching sample logs and trace IDs.

marta: great — sounds tenant-scoped. I will open a targeted support ticket and propose keeping current thresholds but creating a tenant-specific mitigation (rate-limiting or quota bump) and add a canary. Also will propose alert tweak: change critical window to 60m while we investigate.

devin: SGTM. For the alert change, use this snippet in the alert rule (yaml):
```
- alert: SLOBurnCritical
  expr: slo_burn_ratio{route="/v1/generate"} > 3
  for: 60m
```
Open a PR to alerts repo and ping ops for an expedited deploy.

marta: filing PR now -> https://git.internal/redwood/alerts/pulls/458. tagging @ops for fast deploy. Thanks all — will post RCA draft once I have traces attached. :thumbsup:
